spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶6:** The interior will that clothes itself in the external natural mind — when Divine Truth from the Lord flows into its understanding — is purified by the perception of what is true and by the willing conformity of the natural mind to Divine order, and it is freed from falsities and made into a regenerate state of life. There is no conflict in that interior will, nor any confusion between the spiritual and the natural, nor any disturbance from opposing inclinations.

**¶7:** However, when a spiritual temptation arises within the person and the natural mind is agitated, this disturbance enters into the person through [GAP-1] hereditary evil inclinations and adverse tendencies of inherited nature that [GAP-2] dominate and overturn the person's state, stirring up and troubling the mind with concupiscence, opposition to good, spiritual desolation, and interior anguish — each according to the dominion those tendencies hold. Likewise, as those tendencies prevail, the inflowing forces from spiritual societies agitate the person through the interior connections to which the person is conjoined.

**¶8:** Again, there are times you will find the influx from the spiritual world is quiescent and at rest for the person, and it comes to pass that [GAP-3] an adverse element enters into the person through the goods and truths appropriated from the external world, or else indeed through some [GAP-4] or through the truths received into the understanding. Again, disturbance and confusion and opposition to good increase in the person, and concupiscence multiplies upon the person together with desolation and anguish — because the good appropriated through the will and the truths received into the understanding are full of falsities from evil, a malicious interior intention. These enter the external natural mind, [GAP-5: REVIEW — falsities from evil mingled] with these appropriated things, and they become conjoined with the evil tendencies already present in the natural person and with the hereditary sin dwelling within — arousing the opposition to good and the concupiscence and the desolation and the anguish, these malignant persuasions of the unregenerate natural mind.

**¶10:** There are times, however, when you will find that what is appropriated into the mind is genuine and free from falsity [GAP-6], so that what is of wisdom and spiritual life in it is greater while what is of falsity and evil is diminished, and the working of evil is lessened from it. Even the surrounding spiritual sphere above is at rest, being purified through the [GAP-7] also the form of the external mind is made tranquil from [GAP-8] and what is of genuine good increases in you through those true goods appropriated into the mind. And they find you at peace and in spiritual rest, as you are rightly ordered in your interior states because of the living remains of good and truth, which are more abundant on account of the wisdom dwelling in those purified affections that are present within. The ones that have brought their works of charity to completion. Their spiritual debts from evil have ceased, while their interior will is at peace [GAP-9] they have been conjoined with those living affections of good that dwell within you. Because of this you will find them within you, at rest in celestial peace, and they proceed from you into expression without conflict; and you are found in a flourishing state of the external mind. Even your works of charity are determined, being rightly ordered according to their proper form, and your understanding of truth is arranged in its right order, as your utterances [GAP-10] your interior will is at peace within you, ascending like rational thought set free into the elevation of the spirit.

**¶11:** When the external natural mind is troubled, you are disturbed through the channels of influx from below — the adverse falsities that enter the mind through external appropriation and the act of receiving from the world. Again, when the channels of influx from the heavens are at peace toward you, and even what is appropriated into the mind is transparent and genuine, your will is found rightly disposed in its proper place, and your interior deliberations are at peace from all disturbance.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The soul that assumes the body, when the Light Mind will come to it, shall be purified by the power of wisdom and obedience, and it is cleansed and made a new man. There is no trouble in (the soul), nor confusion nor disturbance.

However, when a disturbance will arise for him and he will be troubled, this disturbance shall go into him in [these ways], first through his birth-signs and his difficult stars that [rule over him, and] they turn over him and stir him and trouble him with lust and anger and depression and grief, as he wills. Also, as he wills, the powers of heaven shall trouble him through their roots, to which he is attached.

Again, there are times you shall find the powers of heaven are peaceful and tranquil for him, and it comes to [pass that] a difficult part comes into him by the nourishment that he has eaten, or else indeed in some [fruit] or in the water that they have drunk. Again, trouble and confusion and anger will increase in him, and lust multiplies upon him together with depression and grief; because of the nourishment of the bread he has eaten and the water he has drunk, which are full of bothersome parts, a vengeful counsel. They shall enter his body, [mixed in] with these foods, and they even become joined in with the wicked parts of the body and the sin that is in him; transferring the anger and the lust and the depression and the grief, these wicked thoughts of the body.

There are times, however, if you shall find that the nourishment that comes into you is pure [and clean from the darkness], so it is greater in light and life while the waste is less in it, and the evil-doing is diminished from it. Even the atmosphere above is still, being purified through the [powers of the height, and] also the image is calmed from [its troubles, and the light] increases in you through those good parts of the food that come into you. And they find you at ease and tranquil, as you are well governed in your abodes because of the living part, which is greater on account of the light of these justified souls that are in it. The ones that have perfected their deeds. Their dues have ceased, while their soul is carefree [and] they have been allied with these living souls that [are p]resent in you. Due to this you shall find them in you, calm in tranquillity, and they come from you without trouble; and you are found flourishing of body. Even your deeds are determined, being well constructed after their manner, and your doctrines are in order, as your words [are pure and] your soul is carefree within you, ascending like a bird.

when [your bo]dy is troubled, you shall be troubled by the conduits of they below, the difficult parts that come into you by food and the act of eating. Again, when the conduits above are calmed from you, even your food that has come into you is clear and pure. Your heart shall be found ordered in its place, your counsels at peace from disturbance.

fills.explanation: The word "first" immediately after the gap signals an enumerated list of channels through which disturbance enters; "in these ways" is the natural framing phrase for such a list in Kephalaia expository style.

The spiritual reading specifies "dominate and overturn," where "overturn" maps to "turn over him"; GAP-2 must supply the domination element, and in Manichaean astrology difficult stars "rule over" a person during their ascendancy.
The idiom "it comes to pass that" is a standard Kephalaia transitional phrase, and the spiritual reading confirms "it comes to pass that an adverse element enters."

The text lists three intake categories — nourishment/bread eaten, some [GAP-4], and water drunk; in the Manichaean Elect's diet as described throughout the Kephalaia, the standard triad is bread, fruit, and water.

The editor's "mixed in" accurately expresses the spiritual reading's "mingled" — falsities from evil are mixed in with the appropriated foods, a standard Manichaean concept of dark matter intermixed with nourishment.

The spiritual reading says "genuine and free from falsity"; in the Kephalaia's natural register, falsity corresponds to darkness, and "pure and clean from the darkness" sets up the contrast with "greater in light and life" that immediately follows.

In ¶7, the "powers of heaven" disturb through their roots; here in the peaceful state, the atmosphere is purified through those same powers now quiescent — "powers of the height" is the standard Kephalaia term for heavenly governing forces.

The spiritual reading says "made tranquil from [troubles] and what is of genuine good increases"; in the Kephalaia, the image (form) is calmed from its troubles, and "light" is the standard natural-plane term for genuine good that increases through pure nourishment.

The gap connects two parallel conditions — the soul being carefree and being allied with living souls — in a coordinated list of peaceful states; "and" is the natural copulative connector, with the causal link supplied by "Due to this" in the following sentence.

The passage follows a parallel pattern — deeds are determined, doctrines in order, words are [state], soul is carefree; "pure" describes truthful utterance aligned with good, and parallels "clear and pure" used of nourishment in the matching passage of ¶11.
